cards.audioText: Do you prefer day flight or night flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢飞日间航班还是夜间航班？
cards.referenceText: I prefer flying in day time, because the visibility is good in day time, and it is more safely to fly under good visibility, also, we can have a better and regular rest in the day flight. I prefer flying in night time, because there are few planes at night and we don't need to wait or delay, especially for the pilots of cargo planes, time always comes first.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我喜欢飞日间航班，因为白天能见度较好，在这样的情况下飞行更安全，同时飞飞日间航班，我们能够更好更规律地休息。我喜欢飞夜间航班，因为晚上飞机少，我们不需要等待或延误，尤其对于货机飞行员来说，时间总是排在第一位的。

cards.audioText: What are the differences between day flight and night flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 白天飞行与夜间飞行有什么不同？
cards.referenceText: There are some differences between day flight and night flight. During day flight, we will have better visual reference. During night flight, it will be difficult for the pilots to have visual contact with runway, as a result, pilots needs to use ground equipment to have a safe landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 白天飞行和夜间飞行有一些不同。白天飞行期间，我们有更多的目视参考。夜间飞行期间，飞行员很难对跑道建立目视参考，因此，飞行员需要使用地面设备进行安全着陆。

cards.audioText: What are the difference between day flight and night flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 白天飞行与夜间飞行有什么不同？
cards.referenceText: There are some differences between day flight and night flight. During day flight, we will have better visual reference. During night flight, it will be difficult for the pilots to have visual contact with runway, as a result, pilots needs to use ground equipment to have a safe landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 白天飞行和夜间飞行有一些不同。白天飞行期间，我们有更多的目视参考。夜间飞行期间，飞行员很难对跑道建立目视参考，因此，飞行员需要使用地面设备进行安全着陆。

cards.audioText: What are the main differences between flying during the day and flying at night?
cards.audioTextZh: 昼间飞行与夜间飞行的主要区别是什么？
cards.referenceText: Day flight usually provides better outside visual references, so landmarks, terrain, and objects are easier to see. At night, those references and visual contact with the runway are more limited, so pilots depend more on instruments and airport lighting. Visual illusions are also more likely at night.
cards.referenceTextZh: 昼间飞行通常有更好的外部目视参照，因此地标、地形和物体更容易看清。夜间这些参照和与跑道的目视接触更有限，飞行员会更依赖仪表和机场灯光。夜间也更容易产生视觉错觉。

cards.audioText: What are the main components of a runway lighting system?
cards.audioTextZh: 跑道灯光系统主要由哪些部分组成？
cards.referenceText: The main runway lighting components include runway edge lights, centerline lights, threshold lights, and touchdown-zone lights.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道灯光的主要组成包括跑道边灯、中线灯、入口灯和接地区灯。

cards.audioText: Which airport visual aids help pilots land safely at night?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些机场目视助航设施可以帮助飞行员在夜间安全着陆？
cards.referenceText: Useful visual aids include approach lights, runway edge lights, runway centerline lights, and PAPI lights.
cards.referenceTextZh: 有用的目视助航设施包括进近灯、跑道边灯、跑道中线灯和 PAPI 灯。

cards.audioText: What is the purpose of an aircraft's navigation lights?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机航行灯的作用是什么？
cards.referenceText: Navigation lights help other pilots identify an aircraft's orientation, especially at night. The red light is on the left, the green light is on the right, and a white light is visible from the rear. They support visual recognition and collision avoidance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 航行灯帮助其他飞行员判断飞机方向，夜间尤其重要。左侧红灯、右侧绿灯，后方可见白灯，有助于目视识别和防撞。

cards.audioText: What functions does runway lighting provide during night operations?
cards.audioTextZh: 跑道灯光在夜间运行中发挥哪些作用？
cards.referenceText: Runway lighting makes the runway boundaries and centerline easier to see at night. It helps pilots judge their position, align the aircraft with the runway, and conduct safer takeoffs and landings.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道灯光使飞行员在夜间更容易看清跑道边界和中线。它有助于判断位置、使飞机与跑道对正，并更安全地起飞和着陆。
